images.subject: A fusion power plant built around one colossal upright ring-shaped tokamak containment torus. On the right side of the frame, at the foot of the cliff, stands a second large and clearly separate block: two giant cooling towers releasing thick white plumes of steam, linked to the ring by thick pipes.
images.detail: Blue-white plasma glows brightly through wide windows along the ring.
